statement: Recent event tokens and player trading make companion bonuses more accessible.
The ranking emphasizes bonuses and accessibility and quality of life rather than price.
Eighty pets exist excluding championship pets.
Each character needs at least level-two Divinity to activate Doot's bonuses.
Doot activates all gods even those not yet unlocked when entering World 5.
Doot remains S tier for early-to-late-game power and convenience but is no longer the strongest pet and declines at endgame.
Rift Slug adds twenty-five levels to talents with at least one invested point rather than granting spendable talent points.
Rift Slug is excellent early and deserves A tier but its twenty-five levels no longer justify S.
Ram enables storage from anywhere through Quick Ref.
Ram is easy to obtain and free-to-play friendly with major convenience but Piggy is better.
Crystal Custard gives 100% drop rate and class XP which he believes are additive.
Crystal Custard helps early but falls off when drop rate reaches thousands or hundreds of thousands.
Sheepie passively equips all big alchemy bubbles.
Sheepie supports gems and samples plus sailing and gaming procs and multikill without manual bubble swaps.
Doot becomes powerful at level-two Divinity while Sheepie needs developed big bubbles to become comparably potent.
Sheepie deserves S tier for power and convenience and is easy to obtain.
Mutated Mush grants 5% all-skill efficiency.
After initially considering C he creates D tier and places Mutated Mush there.
Bored Bean grants 5% AFK gains for combat and skills.
Bored Bean's 5% helps early but falls off quickly so he ranks it D despite joking about F.
Slime increases arcade golden-ball earnings by 25%.
Slime deserves C because capped arcade-ball acquisition makes golden-ball bonuses useful even though progression remains slow.
Sandy Pot grants fifteen base all stats which scale with all-stat percentage.
Sandy Pot's base stats can outscale weaker pets and may provide more efficiency than Mutated Mush's 5% later.
Bloque grants 20% additive all-skill XP.
Bloque is F tier because a small skill-XP bonus has little impact even early.
Frog supplies 10% additive total damage.
He considers Frog around C or upper D while noting Sandy Pot's base stats eventually scale better.
Use the top-left eye button to switch to the legacy companion pool.
Roll legacy pets first targeting Sheepie and Ram and Rift Slug plus Doot if possible.
Ancient Golem gives a true ten-times damage multiplier on top of other bonuses.
He rejects A tier as too low for Ancient Golem's true damage multiplier.
Multipliers within one bucket add together while a final separate true-multiplier bucket multiplies preceding buckets.
He tests Ancient Golem using a 17.5-trillion damage reference and concludes it is a true multiplier.
True multipliers are especially valuable for drop rate as well as damage.
Samurai Guardian grants three-times villager XP and twenty-five opals.
The bonus helps unlock hole progression through conjuror and study rate and engineer schematics especially on younger accounts.
He lowers Samurai Guardian from possible strong A to B because its impact falls off later.
Rift Joc doubles kills credited toward portals and Death Note.
Rift Joc belongs near the top of A for new-world pushing and speedruns plus Death Note and green mushroom farming.
With the lab jewel Fungi Finger Pocketer grants 3.5% cash per million green mushroom kills.
Leek Spirit multiplies Equinox bar fill rate by 3.5.
He ranks Leek Spirit above Samurai Guardian near the top of B.
Crystal Capybara grants 1.75-times lab and divinity XP.
Crystal Capybara is particularly helpful early and remains useful for pushing later skill levels.
Big Mole grows printer samples one percent daily for one hundred days up to one hundred percent growth.
He ranks Big Mole below Ram and Rift Slug around upper B.
Big Mole takes about three months to peak so an early account may leave early game before fully benefiting.
Gigafrog grants 25% carry capacity for every item type.
Carry capacity deserves A because larger golden-food stacks increase drop rate and AFK gains plus stats and damage.
Mashed Potato adds 5% to the World 2 Ballot bonus multiplier.
He settles on D because the small bonus still improves divinity-point weeks.
Flying Worm grants thirty talent points for classes.
Flying Worm's points do not apply to masterclass talents.
Flying Worm is F tier; ordinary character leveling supplies points and the masterclass exception removes its proposed niche.
Poisonic Frog supplies 15% defense.
Enough FMJ makes the small Poisonic Frog defense bonus negligible.
Quenchie grants 15% drop rate which he considers small despite valuing drop rate.
Green Mushroom supplies 15% accuracy.
Green Mushroom belongs in F because normal progression solves accuracy.
Walamus provides ten-times class XP and ten legend talent points.
In World 7 character level thresholds award legend points for strong bonuses.
He retracts an initial S ranking because Walamus supplies a strong head start rather than overwhelming lasting power.
Balloonfish quadruples monster coins and masterclass drops.
Balloonfish greatly accelerates time-gated masterclass benefits such as Prisma bubbles and exalted stamps.
Balloonfish could become stronger if future masterclasses add more drops.
Pufferblob adds 50% Meritocracy bonus multiplier.
Pufferblob is strong A but below Poppy's different level of power.
Once sufficiently progressed in World 7 Meritocracy largely determines the week's activity priorities.
Shell Slug grants 1.75-times daily reef coral.
He has owned Shell Slug since about day three and has abundant coral.
Shell Slug ranks around upper C or lower B because there are not enough essential coral purchases.
Crystal Cuttlefish adds 40% World 2 Ballot bonus multiplier.
He settles on B because Ballot has powerful weeks but also weak additive-XP weeks.
Kills-per-kill and divinity weeks are strong while additive XP weeks are weak.
Endgame weekly priorities usually depend on a combination of Ballot and Meritocracy.
A pet's potency should not be judged solely by players voting poorly.
Easy Earl adds one grade to two gallery showcases.
Easy Earl can help without all gallery slots but becomes weak or useless once those slots are purchased.
Litterfish grants 1.25-times artifact find chance.
Litterfish is a nice incidental bonus but not crucial because sailing favors quantity over quality.
Spearfish adds one friend-bonus slot.
High-level friends can grant enough damage and efficiency for beginners to one-shot World 1 and 2 monsters.
Some friend bonuses are weak additive XP while others are useful especially early.
Equinox Broadbass multiplies monster coins by 1.5.
He revises Broadbass from A to upper B because stronger coin-multiplier pets exist.
Money remains useful for vault and other expensive upgrades and coin multipliers combine strongly with green mushroom bonuses.
Mafioso grants 15% alchemy brew speed.
Mafioso's small brew-speed bonus is F tier.
Baby Boa grants 10% additive class XP.
He considers Baby Boa worse than Mafioso and poor value.
He recalls buying a twenty-dollar Ramsay premium hat for 11% additive XP.
Purple Mushroom grants 5% golden-food bonus which he considers negligible.
Cool quadruples monster coins versus Broadbass's 1.5-times bonus.
He ranks Cool high A near Walamus because money is important.
Axolotl supplies 50% additive AFK gains.
Axolotl belongs around lower B rather than S though its AFK bonus benefits from the golden-food AFK multiplier.
Mallard grants 1.3-times drop rate which he considers extremely strong.
Spirit Reindeer doubles gold-ball shop bonuses.
His arcade upgrades are all maxed and cosmic making Reindeer especially powerful for him.
He chooses lower S because Reindeer covers many bonuses but needs substantial arcade investment.
Reindeer supports what he calls the game's highest burger percentage.
Obtain Spirit Reindeer only with a strong arcade shop; it is poor value early and good later.
Riptide grants 30% World 7 skill AFK gains and one world-class gallery showcase slot.
Use world-class showcases for the World 6 trophy and Luckiest Lad and Darter trophies.
These trophies supply large account bonuses including AFK and damage and drop-rate multipliers plus drop-rate percentage.
He leaves Riptide in S but considers it closer to A-plus if the other showcases are already owned.
Squirrel multiplies portal and Death Note kill credit by 1.5.
He places Squirrel near Rift Joc and rejects B as too low despite its weaker multiplier.
Piggy doubles friend bonuses and adds two slots plus auto-loot and Quick Ref storage and infinite teleports.
He strongly recommends tokening tradable Piggy for fully free-to-play players.
Piggy removes the need to buy storage or roll Ram and provides valuable infinite teleporting and auto-loot.
He believes the whole game can be played free-to-play with Piggy alone and no further pet purchases.
Piggy is top S for the general player base especially new players avoiding spending.
Wild Boar adds 15% Hat Rack bonus multiplier.
He ranks Wild Boar around upper C because its value depends heavily on owning older limited hats.
He bought Diamond Horns and found the bonus disappointing.
Whale doubles class XP and all-skill XP.
Whale belongs in B because the multipliers are useful but modest.
Chippy doubles total damage and class XP.
He refuses to put Chippy as low as the discussed C-tier pets.
Bunny triples class XP.
He ranks Bunny above C and thinks viewers underestimate class-XP multipliers.
Paid damage and drop rate and class XP are so common that players underestimate how much power comes from purchases.
Panda doubles salts produced by refinery.
Panda helps one of the largest early time gates especially Nullo salts.
Salts are needed for level-thirteen vials and traps plus gear and tools so double production eases many progression gates.
Hedgehog grants 200% golden-ball gains.
Hedgehog belongs in B if Slime is C.
Bubba the Seal adds 30% gallery multiplier.
After clarifying it affects trophies he considers boosting all three by 30% better than improving one showcase via Riptide.
Santa Snake combines additive class XP and drop rate with 1.1-times class XP and 1.01-times drop rate.
Santa Snake ranks low C and scales better than Crystal Custard because it includes multipliers.
Santa's Little Helper triples Orion and Poppy and Bubba bonuses and applies to future clickers.
He rejects low rankings for Santa's Little Helper and places it around below Panda while urging players to develop clickers.
Jellyfish grants 1.5-times research XP.
Jellyfish deserves A because research gates many World 7 unlocks and should be pushed aggressively.
Koifish multiplies gaming bits by one hundred and speeds progress.
He discounts a near-max-Snail player's low assessment because that account already has unusually many bits.
Neon Scale adds one research shape after research level twenty.
Because shapes appear in sequence the additional shape helps progress toward stronger shapes and bonuses.
Pirate Deckhand multiplies every research-grid bonus by 1.15.
He considers Pirate Deckhand at least A and a possible S gatekeeper including its palette-luck benefit.
Dreadnought Captain makes Glimbo swap-meet prices five times cheaper.
A five-times Glimbo cost reduction is extremely strong.
Baby Troll grants 100% additive class XP and 1.5-times class XP.
Mama Troll grants 100% additive drop rate and a 1.5-times multiplier making it better than Mallard.
Boomy Mine gives twenty-times spelunking power and double Minehead currency.
He lowers Boomy Mine below Deckhand because spelunking power becomes redundant and Minehead remains heavily time-gated.
Glimbo grants 1.6-times kills and doubles sailing artifact find chance.
He raises the kill-multiplier pets because the extra kills remain valuable alongside sailing benefits.
Vanilla supplies 2500% additive golden-food bonus.
He places Vanilla at the top of C.
Valentine Slime grants 15% total damage or five percentage points more than Frog.
Crystnake makes all vault upgrades fifty percent cheaper.
He places Crystnake near bottom A because Glimbo makes vault cost reductions increasingly valuable.
Mechanical Mouse doubles construction build speed as a true multiplier.
He places Mechanical Mouse above the carry-capacity pet because its construction multiplier is strong.
Construction does not end at level-one-hundred towers; even dedicated endgame players remain unfinished.
An unnamed pet is described as granting 100% class XP and drop rate.
Egg Roll triples class XP and is ranked next to Bunny.
Lucky Slug grants the same 15% drop rate as Quenchie.
He places Lucky Slug higher within D largely for appearance despite the identical bonus.
Hot Luck multiplies monster coins by 2.5 and ranks near upper B.
Manta Ray multiplies all Button bonuses by 1.5.
Button bonuses include XP and artifacts plus cooking and Minehead and masterclass resources and crop evolution and sushi and spelunking.
Wickerlight Spirit makes meals five times cheaper to level and multiplies their bonuses by 1.25.
Golden cakes are among the largest sources of drop-rate improvement.
Rift Spooker triples cooking mastery XP and grants five cooking mastery points.
He initially places Rift Spooker around upper B or A and rejects S.
He revises upward after considering Yummy Peach Ring scaling and argues its multiplier should be valued consistently with meal multipliers.
Rift Hive Mind gives 50% Prisma bonus multiplier and fifty fragments equivalent to five Prisma bubbles.
He considers the Prisma multiplier extremely strong especially for players who missed earlier gem-shop Prisma sales.
Riftstalker grants ten research points and 20% research AFK gains plus double research XP and one magnifier.
He considers Riftstalker upper A or S and would place it above Panda.
Smoke Devil grants one-hundred-times jade and forty-times ninja stealth plus a 2.5-times sneaking bonus.
Funeral Flower lowers Smoke Devil's relative value because dying more provides an alternative progression method.
Royal Egg doubles monument levels when selecting rewards rather than doubling all existing bonuses.
He ranks Royal Egg around B because newer bonuses let players largely neglect the mechanic despite some endless rewards.
Abacus Frog currently does nothing.
He jokingly puts Abacus Frog in its own lawsuit tier because it resembles Yoshi.
Crystal Clam gives 1.4-times class XP and 1.3-times drop rate plus a corrected 1.2-times kill multiplier.
He ranks Crystal Clam above comparable drop-rate-only pets because it includes additional benefits.
Glunko Supreme is excluded because it does not exist.
Glunko the Massive triples total damage and gives five-times class XP plus 1.5-times drop rate.
Poppy doubles Ballot and Meritocracy bonuses.
Poppy may be the strongest pet overall and even better than Piggy for power.
Piggy remains the most free-to-play friendly because tokens and trading bypass its paid pack.
Bin Goosey gives daily ribbons the stated chances of extra tiers: fifty-five percent plus one and forty-five plus three and ten plus five.
He places Bin Goosey around upper A or lower S depending on account needs.
Ribbons attach to meal plates and improve their effects.
Companions are unusually strong overall so the tier list naturally contains many A and S pets.
For fully free-to-play players lacking Ram and auto-loot he strongly recommends Piggy first.
Choose Doot next for immediate World 5 benefits before the account can fully exploit Poppy.
Continue free legacy rolls; rolling Doot naturally refunds the token previously spent on its bonus.
Ultimately put the refunded token on Poppy because its weekly bonuses define the current late-game meta.
